provenance.sourceOrg: Harris County Clerk's Office Elections Department
provenance.quote:
CITY OF HOUSTON, PROPOSITION A
CIUDAD DE HOUSTON, PROPOSICIÓN A
Shall the City Charter of the
City of Houston be amended
to 1) require the Houston
Police Department to make
enforcement of Class A and
Class B misdemeanor
marijuana possession its
lowest law-enforcement
priority with related reporting
requirements and 2) prohibit
Houston police officers from
requesting or executing "no-
knock" search warrants?
¿Debería modificarse la Ley
Orgánica de la ciudad de Houston
para: 1) exigir al Departamento de
Policía de Houston que considere la
persecución de los delitos menores
de clase A y clase B por posesión de
marihuana como su prioridad más
baja en materia de aplicación de la
ley, con los correspondientes
requisitos de información, y 2)
prohibir a los agentes de policía de
Houston solicitar o ejecutar órdenes
de registro “sin previo aviso”?
FOR A FAVOR
AGAINST EN CONTRA

scopedCoverageNotes.text: All 14 pages of Harris County's official November 3, 2026 General and Special Elections composite sample were acquired and parsed. This packet covers 137 judicial/local candidate contests (270 printed named choices) and all 38 printed local measure questions. Federal, statewide executive, statewide Supreme Court/Criminal Appeals, State Board of Education, and legislative fields are preserved in parsed-all.json and are outside this local install.

Six unopposed seats declared elected (Crosby ISD districts 1/3/4/5 and North Harris County Regional Water Authority districts 2/3) are recorded in declared-elected.json rather than fabricated voting contests. The separate official notice names 31 cancelled elections.

The official declared-write-in list is preserved separately: 14 names across six office fields, including County Judge (2) and County Commissioner Precinct 4 (1). Blank Write-in spaces are excluded from printed candidate totals. Reader representation of declared write-ins remains open.

Composite coverage describes only elections administered and printed by Harris County. It does not prove every independent jurisdiction touching Harris County contracted with the county or held an election. No whole-county completeness is asserted.

Every source-printed electorate is retained separately. The 41 district-judge electorates already have source-backed whole-Harris-County memberships in held TX data, preserved by the partial merge. The checked-in registry and held memberships do not resolve the 23 precise IDs listed in unresolved-reader-divisions.json; the live registry has not been checked here. Reader division or boundary links remain open until resolved. No precinct, council district, water-authority director district, township, or special district is widened to the county or a CDP.
